meta.title: Monster Cannon — Aim. Bounce. Destroy everything.
meta.description: The roguelike cannon game where every shot counts. Ricochet your ball, survive endless waves, upgrade your cannon. Zero forced ads, zero paywall. Coming soon to Google Play.
meta.ogDescription: Free roguelike arcade game, no forced ads. Pre-register for beta access + an exclusive launch skin.

hero.subtitle: Launch your ball, ricochet it off the walls, pierce through hordes of monsters and survive <hl>endless waves</hl>. Upgrade your cannon run after run.

problem.heading: Let's be honest: mobile games have let you down.

pains.title: An ad every 30 seconds
pains.body: You clear 2 levels and BAM — 30 seconds of an ad you can't skip. The "free game" costs you your patience.

pains.title: The disguised paywall
pains.body: "Want to keep going? $4.99 or wait 6 hours." The fun is held hostage by your wallet.

pains.title: Gameplay with no depth
pains.body: Tap, tap, tap. No decisions, no skill, no reason to come back. Uninstalled in 3 days.

problem.agitation: You download a game to unwind for 5 minutes, not to get harassed. The worst part? These games could be great — but they're built to extract money from you, not to entertain you.

solution.heading: Monster Cannon is the complete opposite. 💥
solution.valueProp: The pure satisfaction of a ball that ricochets perfectly — like a clean pool shot — with the depth of a real roguelike. You progress through skill, never through your credit card.

benefits.title: A deeply satisfying core move
benefits.body: Touch, drag, aim, release. Your ball bounces off the walls and pierces through monsters. A single shot that clears half the screen after 4 bounces? That thrill is exactly what you'll keep chasing.

benefits.title: Endless waves, never twice the same
benefits.body: The difficulty rises forever. The further you go, the more intense it gets. Your high score is never safe — there's always "one more wave" to reach.

benefits.title: Roguelike progression that makes you stronger
benefits.body: Between each wave, pick one upgrade out of 3: +damage, piercing ball, lifesteal, explosions… Every run builds a unique build. You die, you restart, you go further.

benefits.title: Honest free-to-play. Promise.
benefits.body: Zero forced ads. Zero paywall. Ads are 100% optional (a revive if YOU want it). Unlock skins by beating bosses, not by pulling out your card.

items.headline: Every boss teaches you a new way to play.
items.body: Every 10 waves, a boss introduces a new mechanic: obstacles, moving enemies, shields, splitting monsters… They stack up. By wave 50, you're juggling them all at once.

items.headline: The more you think, the more damage you deal.
items.body: A dotted line shows you the next 3 bounces before you fire. Bank off the walls, hit enemies hiding behind obstacles, chain ricochets. Skill is seeing the shot others can't.

items.headline: Always a good reason to come back tomorrow.
items.body: Beat bosses to unlock cannon skins (Bronze → Legendary). Collect 15 achievements. Log in 7 days in a row for the exclusive Rainbow skin.

items.headline: 30 seconds or 30 minutes — you decide.
items.body: Tutorial in under 60 seconds, instant run. Perfect for the commute or a coffee break. Your high score and coins are always there when you come back.

items.headline: It punches, it rumbles, it rewards.
items.body: Screen shake, impact flashes, vibration on every shot, punchy SFX and music that ramps up on bosses. Every monster you pop is a micro-reward.

trust: ✅ Built with Unity — 60 FPS, under 100 MB

items.a: A roguelike arcade game: you control a cannon, you fire balls that bounce off walls and pierce through monsters. Survive endless waves of rising difficulty by upgrading your cannon every wave.
Yes, 100% free. A free-to-play model funded by optional rewarded ads only. No mandatory in-app purchases, no forced ads.
Android (Google Play) at launch. Pre-registration is open right now.

items.q: When does the game come out?
items.a: Soon — the game is in active development. Pre-register to be notified on launch day and get priority beta access.

items.q: How do I join the beta?
items.a: Enter your email and check "I want to test the beta". We send invites in waves to the first sign-ups.

items.q: Do I need an internet connection to play?
items.a: The game is playable offline. A connection is only used for the optional rewarded ads.

items.q: What do I get by pre-registering now?
items.a: Priority beta access, an exclusive launch cannon skin (reserved for life for pre-registered players) and the guarantee of being notified as soon as it's out.

items.q: Will the game be available in English?
items.a: Yes — Monster Cannon is available in French and English from launch.

finalCta.heading: Your cannon is waiting. <hl>Be the first to fire.</hl>
finalCta.supporting: Pre-register today for priority beta access, your exclusive launch skin, and an alert the second the game drops. The only thing you risk is getting hooked.

footer.tagline: Free forever. Zero forced ads, ever.
